question: Does the frozen donor-free q_is additive actuator clear its sole failed hypothesis under a different answer-preserving surface edit?

novelty_search.binding_result: The zero-forward repaired donor-free test is a valid null solely because v2 temporal-paraphrase P reflection is 0.727 below 0.75; all A panels, v3 P, and both C panels pass.
novelty_search.standing_lesson: When one P/C family alone controls a verdict, vary that hypothesis family once while holding the target circuit, other hypotheses, bars, and actuator fixed.
novelty_search.new_question: Replace only P's this/that -> present/previous paraphrase with a same-tense exact-word insertion; do not rerun or alter A/C.
novelty_search.anti_rank_drift: q_is, rank, budget, grid, bar, and all A/C outcomes are frozen. This is a causal control-family robustness test, not a rank or compression search.

frozen_design.rows: Sixteen v2 agents/directions. Base remains 'At this/that moment the AGENT'; donor inserts only 'exact': 'At this/that exact moment the AGENT'. Both sides retain the same is/was answer.
frozen_design.identity: All 48 parent A1/A2/C row dictionaries must remain byte-identical; all 16 P row IDs must be new and unique.
frozen_design.capability_first: Score native base and donor is/was sides before intervention. If either direction/side population accuracy is below 0.85, stop invalid without evaluating the grid.
frozen_design.actuator: Use q_is, budget 7218.272705078125, and the unchanged 257-point donor-free target-guided reflection rule. Donor activation/margin cannot select alpha.
frozen_design.scientific_bar: Mean P margin reflection >=0.75 and direction fraction >=0.75, unchanged from v1.
frozen_design.known_outcomes: A/C and original-P outcomes are open and are not rerun. Alternative-P capability and causal effects are unopened.

predictions.pred_a_row_identity_capability_and_exact: A1/A2/C rows are byte-identical, P rows are new, all four native P direction-by-side cells are >=0.85, and exact head error <=1e-3.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_donor_free_actuator: Basis, budget, grid and reflection rule are unchanged; no donor activation/margin or outcome selects any alpha.
predictions.pred_c_alternative_P_robustness: Alternative P mean margin reflection >=0.75 with direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_exact_coverage_and_price: Exactly 16 unique intervention records, 2 model forwards/32 examples, 4,112 head-grid evaluations, zero fit/backward/update, and no A/C causal reevaluation.

terminal.screen: A-D pass: donor-free q_is additive actuation is robust to a second P family and upstream-controller work is reopened with the original null retained.
